title: SynapX-Harness Extension Activation Receipt
description: Minimal transition evidence for ENABLED -> ACTIVE_FOR_JOB. The receipt is the post-transition attestation; it is NOT itself an authority artifact. Authorization/issuance flows exclusively through the SkillActivationContract, which must be referenced by activation_contract_id. AUTHORIZED state is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE in I2.

to_state.description: T06 minimal protocol: receipt only emits for the final transition.

activation_contract_id.description: ActivationContract reference; absence => receipt cannot be issued.

issuer.description: Only Core Admission may emit this receipt.

transition.description: Audit-friendly transition string; no other transitions accepted.

eligibility_receipt_ref.description: Forwarded from the activation contract for trace reconstruction.
